title: The Bore
description: Adds Bores to the game amongst other boring things
body:
We have the Blaze and the Breeze, now the Bore.
Conecpt by u/Starninja999 on Reddit [[Direct Link](https://www.reddit.com/r/PhoenixSC/comments/1d8hyms/comment/l77qx1t/?context=3)]

Things in the mod:
- "Bore" mob. Has the AI of a Blaze. Hostile, deals 8 damage per hit and drops boron rods. Spawns in Nether Wastes and Badlands
- "Boron Rod" item, can be crafted into Boron Dust with a crafting table. Edible but I advise against it
- "Boron Dust" item used to make Boring Potions and Arrows
- "Boring Potion" effects you with Bored and lasts 15 mins. Traps you until you die from boredom or you remove the effect with a milk bucket (Stand in the centre to remove it correctly)
- "Boing Stand" uses stacks of clay and turns it into Bore spawn eggs (will probably be chaned in the future)
